title: Storage PRO Scenario Completeness and Silent Refresh Access-Denied Hardening
summary: Completes the Storage PRO operator scenario pass with structured API error evidence, method-aware storage action permissions, complete archive/retention/reconciliation/migration UI scenarios, and precise silent-refresh access-denied classification.
changelog: Completes storage route metadata and action permission coverage for archive roots, retention, reconciliation and migration.
Preserves structured API error status/detail so storage blockers and permission failures stay truthful in the UI.
Improves Storage PRO scenario models for archive root health, retention preview/apply, reconciliation and migration states.
Keeps the last valid storage status visible during silent refresh failures and shows a non-fatal stale warning.
Narrows storage access-denied classification to real 401/403 and explicit auth/permission phrases, avoiding generic unavailable wording.
